label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Sneha it's ok, I'm breathing 😄 and Rohan it's a fair question da. you put real money in, you have every right to ask.

@Ajay cricket captain is accurate btw. "the boys gave 100 percent, we'll take the positives and come back stronger."

ok, straight answer.

yes, I let 6 people go last friday. we were 14, now we're 8. everyone got 2 months pay and I've helped 4 of them get interviews already. it was the worst day of my life. worse than failing maths in 2nd sem, and you guys saw me that day.

why it happened: we had a bridge round coming from a fund in Hyderabad. term sheet was basically ready. it fell through on 28 Oct. the partner told me "we love the energy" on the call and then stopped replying for 11 days. so if anyone ever says they love your energy, please check your bank balance immediately.

where it stands now: after the cuts we have about 5 months of runway. the app has around 41k monthly users. the plumbers and electricians side is growing. AC servicing was bleeding money, so we're shutting that. the plan is to focus on housing society tie-ups, and 3 societies in HSR have already signed pilots.

now your 3 lakh. it is not gone. it is also not safe, and I'm not going to tell you it's safe because I genuinely don't know. it's at risk. I think we have a real shot with the societies, I wouldn't be doing this otherwise, but it's not a sure thing and I won't pretend it is. if the society thing works, we have a proper business. if it doesn't, 5 months is 5 months.

so what to tell Divya: yes it's still a thing, it's at risk, and Karthik is calling us this week. sad face you can keep in reserve. don't deploy it yet.

and I mean that about the call. this deserves more than a group chat between dosa plans. let me call you and Divya properly this week and show you the actual numbers, what's in the bank, what we're burning, what the pilots look like. ask me anything, including the uncomfortable stuff. just tell me which evening works.

for everyone else, before someone starts a collection: I'm fine. I am eating Maggi at the office at 11pm so often that the security uncle now asks me "masala or plain?" before I even sit down. and amma asked last week if TCS is still hiring. very casually. while serving rice. I told her I'll check.

so no funeral please. I'm coming saturday, I want dosa and beer in whatever order Pranav wants, and Pranav is buying. this has been decided.
